name: vaccine adverse events overview
title: Vaccine adverse event decision chart: an event within 6 weeks of immunisation is reported whatever its cause; sort it into allergy to a component, a known reaction to the vaccine, a defective vaccine, a problem with how it was given, or coincidence, then decide whether the next dose is contraindicated, needs a precaution, or is left to public health

nodes.title: Event within 6 weeks of a vaccine: did the VACCINE cause it, and can the NEXT dose go ahead?
lines: EVERY adverse event following immunisation (AEFI) → AEFI form to the local Public Health Unit: MANDATORY for immunisers
PRECAUTIONS before any dose: moderate or severe acute illness · a LIVE vaccine when immunocompromised or pregnant

nodes.title: The VACCINE, how it was MADE, or how it was GIVEN
lines: the shot caused it

nodes.title: NOT the vaccine
lines: after it in time, not caused by it

nodes.title: Allergy to a component
lines: e.g. polyethylene glycol (PEG) in the Pfizer mRNA vaccine

nodes.title: A known reaction to the vaccine
lines: the event fits that vaccine type

nodes.title: A defective vaccine
lines: a component made wrongly

nodes.title: How it was GIVEN
lines: an error, or the patient's anxiety

nodes.title: Coincidence
lines: independent of the vaccine

nodes.title: ANAPHYLAXIS
lines: after MMR, tetanus, hepatitis B or mRNA vaccines

nodes.title: Live
lines: • rotavirus → intussusception
• MMR → febrile seizures, low platelets

nodes.title: Inactivated · toxoid
lines: • whole-cell pertussis → prolonged crying, seizures, hypotonic hyporesponsive episode
• diphtheria → high fever, febrile seizures

nodes.title: Newer platforms
lines: • viral vector → vaccine-induced immune thrombotic thrombocytopenia (VITT), Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS)
• mRNA → myocarditis (dose 2), Bell's palsy

nodes.title: e.g. PARALYSIS
lines: after oral polio vaccine that was not inactivated enough

nodes.title: Error
lines: contaminated vial → abscess at the injection site

nodes.title: Anxiety
lines: • fainting (syncope)
• hyperventilation

nodes.title: e.g. a fractured radius, a UTI
lines: still counts as an AEFI

nodes.title: ABSOLUTE contraindication
lines: to that vaccine or component
treat it now: see the ALLERGY chart

nodes.title: ABSOLUTE: encephalopathy after a pertussis vaccine
PRECAUTION before the next dose
lines: • extensive limb swelling or high fever after the last dose
• GBS within 6 weeks of a flu vaccine

nodes.title: Public health advises on the next dose
lines: the medical officer of health (MOH) or public health nurse reviews the report
